articles.summary: Spire Global, Inc. has been awarded a $3.7 million contract by the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) for satellite weather data from September 18 through December 1, 2026.
articles.title: Spire Global Awarded $3.7 Million NOAA Contract for Satellite Weather Data

articles.summary: Spire Global, Inc. has been awarded a $3 million, six-month contract extension by the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) to continue evaluating data from Spire’s Hyperspectral Microwave Sounder (HyMS).
articles.title: Spire Global Awarded $3 Million NOAA Contract Extension for Hyperspectral Microwave Sounder Data

articles.summary: Contract builds on Spire's previous €3 million award and increases delivery of radio occultation observations to support weather forecasting across Europe
articles.title: EUMETSAT Awards Spire Global €4 Million One-Year Contract Renewal and Expansion for Satellite Weather Data
